sentences.text: David Mazouz -LRB- -LSB- dəˈviːd_məˈzuːz -RSB- born February 19 , 2001 -RRB- is an American actor .
An early role of his was that of the young autistic Jacob `` Jake '' Bohm in the TV series Touch .	Touch	Touch (TV series)

He portrays a young Bruce Wayne in Fox 's TV series Gotham , based on the DC Comics alter ego of the superhero Batman .	Bruce Wayne	Batman	Gotham	Gotham (TV series)	Fox	Fox Broadcasting Company	DC Comics	DC Comics	Batman	Batman
